title: Wolves [V14]

Meant for the now scrapped A Side / B Side single release of "All Day" & "Wolves", which was meant to release on February 24th, 2015 based on Ye's iTunes Artist Page updating, Joe Perez's single art, MIKE DEAN hyping it up on Twitter and Benji B being confused by it's delay on Twitter. Was delayed by a week for unknown reasons and the next release day of March 3rd, 2015, "All Day" released on it's own without "Wolves". Song was purchased from MUSICMAFIA by a Section80 user and eventually leaked in the Feb 2016 leak season.
